allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== npm global claude ==="; \(Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) | Select-Object Name, Source, Version | Format-List; Write-Output "=== where claude ==="; try { \(Get-Command claude -All -ErrorAction Stop\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Source } } catch { "not found in PATH" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== CPU 아키텍처 ==="; $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE; Write-Output "=== Git 설치 여부 \(데스크톱 앱 필수\) ==="; $git = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($git\) { "설치됨: $\($git.Source\)"; git --version } else { "Git 미설치 -> 데스크톱 앱 실행 전 설치 필요" })
